verses.1: Sing this, beside the flowing juice, to him your hero, much-invoked, To please him as a mighty Bull
verses.2: O Satakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine Which is most glorious of all!
verses.3: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two mighty ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.
verses.4: Sing praises that the horse may come; sing, Srutakaksha, that the cow May come, that Indra's might may come
verses.5: We make this Indra very strong to strike, the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous hero shall he be.
verses.6: Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra, is thy birth: Thou, mighty one! art strong indeed,
verses.7: The sacrifice made Indra great when he unrolled the earth, and made Himself a diadem in heaven.
verses.8: If I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single ruler over wealth My worshipper should be rich in kine.
verses.9: Pressers, blend Soma juice for him, each draught most excellent, for him The brave, the hero, for his joy.
verses.10: Here is the Soma juice expressed. O Vasu, drink till thou art full: Undaunted God, we give it thee
verses.11: Surya, thou mountest up to meet the hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for man.
verses.12: Whatever, Vritra-slayer! thou, Surya hast risen upon to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.
verses.13: That Indra is our youthful friend, who with his trusty guidanceled Turvasa, Yadu from afar.
verses.14: O Indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams' light This may we gain with thee for friend!
verses.15: Indra, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid
verses.16: In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra is lesser fight, The friend who bends his bolt at fiends.
verses.17: In battle of a thousand arms Indra drank Kadru's Soma juice There he displayed his manly might.
verses.18: Faithful to thee, we sing aloud, heroic Indra, songs to thee Mark, O good Lord, this act of ours!
verses.19: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway trim the sacred grass, Whose friend is Indra ever young.
verses.20: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long!
verses.21: I Hear, as though 'twere close at hand, the cracking of the whips they hold: They gather splendour on their way.
verses.22: Indra, these friends of ours, supplied with Soma, wait and look to thee As men with fodder to the herd.
verses.23: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men bow down, As rivers bow them to the sea.
verses.24: We choose unto ourselves that high protection of the mighty Gods, That it may help and succour us.
verses.25: O Brahmanaspati, make thou Kakshivan Ausija a loud Chanter of flowing Soma juice!
verses.26: Much honoured with libations may the Vritra-slayer watch for us: May Sakra listen to our prayer
verses.27: Send us this day, God Savitar, prosperity with progeny Drive thou the evil dream away!
verses.28: Where is that ever-youthful Steer, strong-necked and never yet bent down? What Brahman ministers to him?
verses.29: There where the mountains downward slope, there at the meeting of the streams The Sage was manifest by song.
verses.30: Praise Indra whom our songs must laud, sole sovran of mankind, the chief Most liberal who controlleth men
verses.31: Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksha's draught, The Soma juice with barley brew.
verses.32: O Lord of ample wealth, these songs of praise have called aloud to thee, Like milch-kine lowing to their calves!
verses.33: Then straight they recognized the mystic name of the creative Steer, There in the mansion of the Moon.
verses.34: When Indra, strongest hero, brought the streams, the mighty waters down, Pushan was standing by his side.
verses.35: The Cow, the streaming mother of the liberal Maruts, pours her milk, Harnessed to draw their chariots on.
verses.36: Come, Lord of rapturous joys, to our libation with thy bay steeds, come With bay steeds to the flowing juice
verses.37: Presented strengthening gifts have sent Indra away at sacrifice, With night, unto the cleansing bath.
verses.38: I from my Father have received deep knowledge of eternal Law: I was born like unto the Sun.
verses.39: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things, wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice
verses.40: Soma and Pushan, kind to him who travels to the Gods, provide Dwellings all happy and secure.
verses.41: Invite ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma steeds, juice, All-conquering Satakratu, most munificent of all who live
verses.42: Sing ye a song, to make him glad, to Indra, Lord of tawny The Soma-drinker, O my friends!
verses.43: This, even this, O Indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns!
verses.44: For Indra, lover of carouse, loud be our songs about the juice Let poets sing the song of praise.
verses.45: Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof
verses.46: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of good deeds To our assistance duy by day.
verses.47: Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink Sate thee and finish thy carouse!
verses.48: The Soma, Indra, which is shed in saucers and in cups for thee, Drink thou, for thou art lord thereof!
verses.49: In every need, in every fray we call, as friends, to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.
verses.50: O come ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth your song, Companions, bringing hymns of praise
verses.51: So, Lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been expressed for thee with strength: Drink of it, thou who lovest song!
verses.52: Great is our Indra from of old; greatness be his, the Thunderer Wide as the heaven extends his might.
verses.53: Indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand Manifold and nutritious spoil!
verses.54: Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.
verses.55: With what help will he come to us, wonderful, ever-waxing friend? With what most mighty company?
verses.56: Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours Him who is drawn to all our songs.
verses.57: To the assembly's wondrous Lord, the lovely friend of Indra, I Had prayed for wisdom and successs.
verses.58: May all thy paths beneath the sky whereby thou speddest Vyasva on, Yea, let all spaces hear our voice
verses.59: Bring to us all things excellent, O Satakratu, food and strength, For, Indra, thou art kind to us!
verses.60: Here is the Soma ready pressed: of this the Maruts, yea, of this, Self-luminous the Asvins drink.
verses.61: Tossing about, the active ones came nigh to Indra at his birth, Winning themselves heroic might.
verses.62: Never, O Gods, do we offend, nor are we ever obstinate We walk as holy texts command.
verses.63: Evening is come: sing loudly thou Atharvan's nobly singing son: Give praise to Savitar the God!
verses.64: Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear daughter of the Sky: High, Asvins, I extol your praise.
verses.65: Armed with the bones of dead Dadhyach, Indra, with unresisted might The nine-and-ninety Vritras slew.
verses.66: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all our Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength
verses.67: O thou who slayest Vritras, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty one, with thy mighty aids!
verses.68: That might of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth,
verses.69: This is thine own Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest, too, for this our prayer.
verses.70: May Vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: May he prolong our days of life
verses.71: Ne'er is he injured whom the Gods Varuna, Mitra, Aryam. The excellently wise, protect.
verses.72: According to our wish for kine, for steeds and chariots, as of old, Be gracious to our wealthy chiefs
verses.73: Indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught, Aiders, thereby, of sacrifice.
verses.74: That thou much-lauded! many-named! mayst, with this thought, that longs for milk, Come to each Soma sacrifice.
verses.75: May bright Sarasvati, endowed with plenteous wealth and spoil, enriched With prayer, desire the sacrifice.
verses.76: Why 'mid the Nahusha tribes shall sate this Indra with his Soma juice? He shall bring precious things to us.
verses.77: Come, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here: Sit thou on this my sacred grass
verses.78: Great, unassailable must be the heavenly favour of the Three, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.
verses.79: We, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our guide, depend on one like thee, Thou driver of the tawny steeds!
verses.80: Let Soma juices make thee glad! Display thy bounty, Thunderer: Drive off the enemies of prayer!
verses.81: Drink our libation, Lord of hymns! with streams of meath thou art bedewed: Yea, Indra, glory is thy gift.
verses.82: Indra hath ever thought of you and tended you with care. The God, Heroic Indra, is not checked.
verses.83: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea O Indra, naught excelleth thee!
verses.84: Indra, the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
verses.85: May Indra give, to aid us wealth handy that rules the skilful ones! Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth
verses.86: Verily Indra, conquering all, drives even mighty fear away, For firm is he and swift to act.
verses.87: These songs with every draught we pour come, lover of the song, to thee As milch-kine hasten to their calves.
verses.88: Indra and Wishan will we call for friendship and prosperity, And for the winning of the spoil.
verses.89: O Indra, Vritra-slayer, naught is better, mightier than thou Verily there is none like thee!
verses.90: Him have I magnified, our Lord in common, guardian of your folk, Discloser of great wealth in kine.
verses.91: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And with one will have risen to thee!
verses.92: Good guidance hath the mortal man whom Arya-man, the Marut host, And Mitras, void of guile, protect.
verses.93: Bring us the wealth for which we long, O Indra, that which is concealed In strong firm place precipitous.
verses.94: Him your best Vritra-slayer, him the famous champion of mankind I urge to great munificence.
verses.95: Indra, may we adorn thy fame, fame of one like thee, hero! deck, Sakra! thy fame at highest feast!
verses.96: Indra, accept at break of day our Soma mixt with roasted corn, With groats, with cake, with eulogies!
verses.97: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuchi, When thou o'ercamest all the foes.
verses.98: Thine are these Soma juices, thine, Indra, those still to be expressed: Enjoy them, Lord of princely wealth!
verses.99: For thee, O Indra, Lord of light, Somas are pressed and grass is strewn: Be gracious to thy worshippers!
verses.100: We seeking strength, with Soma drops fill full your Indra like a well, Most liberal, Lord of boundless might.
verses.101: O Indra, even from that place come unto us with food that gives A hundred, yea, a thousand powers!
verses.102: The new-born Vritra-slayer asked his mother, as he seized his shaft, Who are the, fierce and famous ones?
verses.103: Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, the highly-lauded, who Fulfils the work to favour us
verses.104: Mitra who knoweth leadeth us, and Varuna who guideth straight, And Aryaman in accord with Gods.
verses.105: When, even as she were present here, red Dawn hath shone from far away, She spreadeth light on every side.
verses.106: Varuna, Mitra, sapient pair, pour fatness on our pastures, pour Meath on the regions of the air!
verses.107: And, at our sacrifices, these, sons, singers, have enlarged their bounds, So that the cows must walk knee-deep.
verses.108: Through all this world strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.
verses.109: Pass by the wrathful offerer; speed the man who pours libation, drink The juice which he presents to thee!
verses.110: What is the word addressed to him, God great and excellently wise? For this is what exalteth him.
verses.111: His wealth who hath no store of kine hath ne'er found out recited laud, Nor song of praises that is sung.
verses.112: Lord of each thing that giveth strength, Indra delighteth most in lauds, Borne by bay steeds, libations' friend.
verses.113: With wealth to our libation come, be not thou angry with us, like A great man with a youthful bride.
verses.114: When, Vasu, wilt thou love the laud? Now let the Channel bring the stream. The juice is ready to ferment.
verses.115: After the Seasons. Indra, drink the Soma from the Brahman's gift: Thy friendship is invincible! S. O Indra, lover of the song, we are the singers of thy praise O Soma-drinker, quicken us!
verses.117: O Indra, in each fight and fray give to our bodies manly strength: Strong Lord, grant ever-conquering might!
verses.118: For so thou art the brave man's friend; a hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thine heart be won to us!
